overview: Important for those who are going to study in Mauritius: There is no specific Bachelor’s in Aerospace Engineering on the official list of undergraduate programs of the University of Mauritius for 2026-2027. Related degrees include Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, and Electrical and Electronic Engineering. These can give you relevant engineering foundations, but are not the same as an aerospace engineering degree. Students planning to **Study Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius** should understand this distinction before choosing a course.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Aerospace Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Aerospace Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Aerospace Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
